value: Minigirl photography game with a handful of roaming girls. Snap photos during giantess actions to complete a photo-album.

You are a member of a collective known as "Tiny", made of people who have shrunk in size for one reason or another.
Your assignment is to retrieve lost items, and take photos that ordinary people can't hope to capture.
Roam around a small town level, with various collectibles to find. Take pictures of girls doing different actions to fill an album. Use collected coins to upgrade your movement abilities.
